result.summary: The page is generally well-designed with clear hierarchy. A few minor visual issues found: a truncated restaurant name, low-contrast elements, and a missing accessible label on the notification button.

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the screen edge with truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol', suggesting an incomplete carousel reveal without an obvious scroll affordance
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has a visible scroll indicator or partial peek of the next card so users know more content exists; allow card names to wrap or ellipsize gracefully

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right (profile/notifications) shows only a red dot with no icon or text label, which may confuse users and lacks an accessible name
issues.suggestion: Add a visible icon (e.g., bell or avatar) and provide an accessibility label describing its purpose

issues.description: Delivery fee text ('€0.90 delivery') under restaurant cards is light gray on white and quite low contrast
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) for small text

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza, -20%) is clipped mid-image with no rating/title visible before the bottom navigation, making it appear cut off
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient padding above the bottom navigation bar or complete card rendering before the fold
